company.name: Power Bank Stations
company.shortDescription: Power Bank Stations is a tech-based company offering charging solutions helping smart devices owners to stay connected
company.description:
Power Bank stations is a network of charging stations for power banks. It solves a super urgent need - to be in touch and charge any gadget on the go. The service allows you to rent a power bank (with cables), charge your device on the move, and return anywhere in our multi-sector network; all through our app.
Our stations are placed at cafes, restaurants, airports, hotels, travel hubs, supermarkets, convenience stores, shopping malls, parks, and events.
